summary: A snow weather: falling flakes, a white battlefield with wind-scoured drifts and churned mud, patchy snow on roofs, trees and the flat tops of vehicles, and thaws round fires and idling engines.
stage: Actual tank movement, engine thaw and untouched powder controls; retained bank comparison
rationale: A compact labeled sequence demonstrates genuine tread generation, 96 seconds of engine thaw, and the wet patch remaining after departure. Matched parked controls distinguish thaw from a vehicle shadow. Previous bank comparison and historical evidence are retained.

overcast_diagnostic.finding: In this overcast scene, disabling probe strengths barely changes the bank/ground contrast. Equal albedo still leaves a strong boundary, including with flat normals: the remaining discrepancy is not explained by texture colour or normals alone. The separate lighting/AO paths need further isolation. No shader fix is proposed from this limited diagnostic. Sunny conditions and border robustness remain unverified.

engine_deck_thaw_2026_11_19.reason: Review on the pull request: the clip had black flecks, and the engine thaw belongs on the tank, not on the ground.
engine_deck_thaw_2026_11_19.flecks: The black flecks were the tank's sub-pixel bolt heads and small dark fittings, aliased to single pixels: the earlier clip came from Mesa llvmpipe, which offers MSAA 4x or none, so Medium's MSAA 2x drew with no anti-aliasing. They hold still on the hull from frame to frame (not falling flakes), and a NaN detector in the surface shader (any NaN or Inf in ALBEDO, NORMAL, ROUGHNESS, METALLIC, SPECULAR or EMISSION painted bright green) found none on a software Vulkan renderer (SwiftShader, Mobile renderer), which shows the same specks. On the GPU at Medium (MSAA 2x) neither renderer shows them. hedge-motion.webm has no black flakes (its flakes are white) and only a few one-pixel specks at car door handles, so it is kept.
engine_deck_thaw_2026_11_19.change: SnowMelt: an idling engine no longer thaws a disc of ground under the hull (reach ~0.55 of the hull's length); its exhaust leaves a patch of EXHAUST_REACH 0.9 m just beyond the outlet (engine_vent), none on a model without one. Mats.SURFACE_SHADER: the deck's warm patch runs from the engine end forward (snow_k.zw = the deck's middle on the hull's line), back to the rear plate, wider and further forward with engine run, the bare metal dark and glossy (thaw_wet) behind a rim of grey slush.

engine_deck_thaw_2026_11_19.renderer: Godot 4.7.2 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090: Forward+ (Vulkan) and Compatibility (OpenGL), Medium (MSAA 2x), 960x540 each, scaled to 800x450 side by side. Appearance only, not performance.
engine_deck_thaw_2026_11_19.staging: As before: three quiet hedge sections and one tank away from combat, driven by order_move/order_stop; nothing painted. Wide camera while it drives in; then from behind over its engine deck (focus 0.5 m behind the tank, zoom 11, pitch -55, yaw -PI/2) while it idles 200 s (48 shots of 100 ticks), and while it drives off.
